subject: Request: split payment / wire window for INV-2026-889
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudlinehealth.com>, Cloudline AP <ap@cloudlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: split payment / wire window for INV-2026-889

Hi Jordan / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-2026-889 (attached). Per our records this invoice is past due by 5 days — thank you for the heads-up you gave last week. We can be flexible: if ACH is blocked on your side, would Cloudline be able to do a partial wire today for 60% and push the remaining 40% on next Tuesday (09/01)? That split would allow us to release service access for the integration cutover this afternoon.

Suggested timeline:
- Today (08/27): 60% via wire
- 09/01 EOD: remaining 40% via ACH or card

If you need the wire details, I've attached a one-page wire instructions template (blank fields for your AP team). If your treasury team requires an AML exception or additional bank reference, let me know and I can loop in Finance.

Attachments: INV-2026-889.pdf, wire_instructions_template.docx

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudlinehealth.com>

Cc: Cloudline AP <ap@cloudlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split payment / wire window for INV-2026-889

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the note and the attachment.

Quick update from AP: our ACH batch this morning failed due to a bank-level reject (they flagged an unusual beneficiary routing). Treasury says they can initiate a full wire but it will clear by COB Monday (08/30) because of internal approvals.

Two asks from us: 
1) If we go full wire, can Redwood confirm the invoice will be marked paid on receipt so we avoid duplicate processing?
2) If partial wire is acceptable, please confirm the bank reference field you want on the wire so our template matches your AP match rule.

I can also put you in touch with our treasury analyst (Marta) if you need a direct handoff.

— Jordan
Director, Revenue Ops | Cloudline Health
jordan.price@cloudlinehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4390

On Fri, 27 Aug 2026 at 11:08 AM, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 11:08:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: split payment / wire window for INV-2026-889

Ben / Laura — quick internal: Cloudline's ACH was rejected and they can place a wire, earliest clearing COB Mon 08/30. They asked that we mark the invoice paid on receipt to avoid duplicate processing.

Ben: operationally, are we comfortable releasing the integration access after a 60% partial wire today (if they do partial), or do we require full wire clearance? They need the access for the cutover.

Laura: if we accept a full wire on Monday, can Finance apply payment on receipt (manual allocation) and confirm no duplicate credit memo will be issued if ACH retries after? Also, if we accept partial wire, what's the minimal documentation Finance needs to reconcile the remainder (bank remittance + payment schedule).

Short answers appreciated so I can confirm with Jordan.

Thanks —
Steph

-----
On Fri, 28 Aug 2026 at 09:22 AM, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudlinehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: split payment / wire window for INV-2026-889

Steph / Ben — quick finance guidance:
- If Cloudline sends a full wire (regardless of ACH retry), Finance will mark INV-2026-889 as paid on settlement confirmation from bank and will not issue a duplicate credit. We will tag the payment method as "wire" and include the inbound transaction id in the ledger.
- For a partial wire, Finance will accept 60% today and hold the remaining balance as open AR with a scheduled follow-up. Remittance advice we need: bank reference/trace number and a short note indicating "60% partial settlement per agreement DL-7892."
- If ACH later clears for the same invoice, we'll treat it as a duplicate incoming payment and will coordinate with Cloudline to apply to future invoices or issue a refund, per their preference. We prefer you get AP to confirm a preferred fallback (refund vs apply to next invoice) ahead of time.

Ben — from ops perspective you can release the integration on evidence of the 60% wire posting (bank confirmation or SWIFT trace) rather than waiting for ACH finality.

Steph — please confirm exact bank reference string they should include. Laura suggests: "CLH-INV889-DL7892" to keep matching simple.

Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2203

Jordan / AP team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our finance team please use the following reference on the wire: CLH-INV889-DL7892.

If you choose partial: please send 60% today and include the SWIFT/trace when available; we will release the integration on bank confirmation. If you choose full wire, we'll mark the invoice paid upon settlement confirmation and follow Finance's process to avoid duplicates.

I'll check back Monday to confirm receipt, or if you can forward the wire confirmation once it posts that would be perfect. Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
